ICS 87.040                          CHD 20(Superseding IS 129 : 1950, IS 870 : 1960 and IS 871 : 1956)Reaffirmed 20221. Scope1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for ready mixed paint, finishing, interior, for general purposes, with distinctive colours as specified below as prescribed in IS 5:2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based onthis standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
